annotations.title: Fill in a metric's history from its feed

description: Run the same frozen instruction over a past range, so a metric has history instead of starting the day it was set up. Offer this whenever you create a feed — a chart with a year behind it is worth far more than one that begins today, and an expectation can be judged against what normal looked like. Works when the source returns a series; a source that only ever reports 'right now' will write one point. Safe to repeat: overlapping ranges dedupe. Keep ranges to a few hundred points; a run that fills up says so. May return `needs_confirmation`.

from.description: Start of the range, ISO date or instant.

to.description: End of the range. Defaults to now.

workspace.description: Workspace slug. Omit to use the pinned workspace.

name: ledger_feeds_backfill
